posts.text: Iran says tankers struck in Hormuz amid fears of new US attack — Iranian forces say five oil tankers and a tugboat have caught fire in several incidents in the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran is Reviewing ‘Concrete Proposals’ on Nuclear Program, Officials Say — Iran’s willingness to re-engage on the issue suggests that Qatar-led diplomatic efforts to avert full-blown war between the U.S. and Iran have had some success.

JD ABANDONS SHIP: IRAN WAR Was Political Disaster — Krystal and Saagar discuss JD abandoning ship after the midterms wipeout criticizing the Iran war. Can Iran’s new supreme leader make peace from behind the scenes? — Mojtaba Khamenei’s consultations suggest a new system of decision-making is taking shape.

Trump administration held talks with Iran on deporting Iranians during the war, court documents show — The documents show that the administration maintained contacts with Iranian officials during the war over the removals, specifically for submitting travel documents and figuring out "possible avenues for removal."

Mamdani distances himself from Hasan Piker's rhetoric, defends having 'conversations' with far-left streamer — Zohran Mamdani tells Shannon Bream he disagrees with Hasan Piker's remarks on Hamas, 9/11 and Iran, but defends engaging with the controversial streamer.

Hegseth faces bipartisan impeachment threat after Iran war gets blame for GOP midterm slaughter — Secretary of War Pete Hegseth faces a bipartisan impeachment threat as House Republicans say a privileged resolution could pass when Congress returns.
Midterm Election Losses Complicate Trump’s Options on Iran War — The midterm results laid bare the deep unpopularity of the war of choice that President Trump started and is now struggling to end.

Hegseth's leadership questioned by GOP military veteran as Democrats talk impeachment — Rep. Don Bacon alleges Pete Hegseth lacks a "moral compass" and says the secretary "doesn't have a lot of friends on the Hill" today.

Multiple flights in Europe diverted because of bomb threats — At least 11 planes from cities, including Dublin, Madrid, and Warsaw, were diverted or grounded over bomb threats that have been determined to be unfounded.

Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how? — Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand spoke with Morning Edition about Democrats' priorities, from lowering costs to ending the Iran war. But questions remain about how they'll deliver.

Republicans turn on Trump after devastating midterm losses hand Democrats control of Congress — GOP insiders blame Trump after Election Night's blue tsunami flipped both chambers, with Democrats scoring seven Senate and 27 House pickups.

Angry, Divided, and Dejected: The GOP Blame Game Has Begun — Tuesday’s humiliating defeat has quickly turned into distancing the Republican Party from some of Trump’s views—but no clear idea how to move on, either with the president or in spite of him, writes Audrey Fahlberg.

How Trump’s Energy Policies Helped Trigger Midterm Rout — The war in Iran, efforts to promote fossil fuels and attacks on renewable energy contributed to higher prices for gas and electricity that drove voter discontent.

What Trump’s Midterm Defeat Means for Iran and Oil Prices — Commentators abroad wondered what President Trump’s electoral losses might mean for oil prices, the war on Iran and the future of American politics.

News Wrap: Officials in Iran welcome midterm results as vote against war — In our news wrap Wednesday, top officials in Iran welcomed the results of the U.S. midterm elections, Israeli President Isaac Herzog says he's accepted the results of last week's election and will consult with party leaders on forming a new government and Ukraine's air force says Russia launched more than 300 drones overnight.

Trump Lost Because He Betrayed America First — The Iran war was the biggest factor in this election. The president started the fight, made himself solely responsible for it, and guaranteed that his party would pay the cost for whatever happened, writes Michael Brendan Dougherty.

More Iranians Call for Nuclear Weapons After War With U.S. — Some Iranian clerics and officials argue the country must rebuild deterrence by dropping its longstanding pledge not to build a nuclear bomb.
